description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - The meeting to fill the Vacancy arose to the Post of Chairman of the Kinniya Pradeshiya Sabha Trincomalee District  Eastern Province
categorisation: This gazette content announces an election-related meeting for the nomination of a new returning officer for the Vadamarachchi North division, scheduled by the District Secretary of the Jaffna District. The primary focus is on the electoral process and the scheduling of a nomination meeting, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7). While a government official (the District Secretary) is named, the content does not describe their detailed portfolio responsibilities or announce a personnel change to the government structure; it instead uses their authority to issue an electoral notice.
